name: Storyblok
description: Storyblok is a headless CMS with a visual, drag-and-drop editor that serves developers with API-first architecture and marketers with intuitive content editing.
best_for: Teams that want a headless CMS combining a developer-friendly, component-based architecture with a visual editor marketers can use directly.
features: Visual, drag-and-drop editor with on-page collaboration
Global, reusable components and flexible content structures
API-first architecture with REST, GraphQL, and Management APIs
MCP server for agentic, AI-driven content access
FlowMotion workflow orchestration for agent-driven publishing tasks
Framework support including Next.js, Astro, Nuxt, React, and Vue
ISO 27001 security certification and 99.99% uptime SLA

alternatives.name: Contentful

alternatives.best_for: Teams needing an enterprise-ready headless CMS with strong API tooling

alternatives.name: Sanity

alternatives.best_for: Developers wanting full data ownership and a self-hostable headless CMS
